replace_files.name: control
replace_files.reason: Match pinned Hibiscus OpenStackClient requirements.txt: openstacksdk>=4.19.0, for both build/test and runtime dependencies. Its volume-message command imports SDK message resource introduced by e997af6fd72086419ebd89b4fcd4259390fccb4f (first released in4.16.0); archive4.7.2 lacks it. Preserve all tests and use the full declared upstream minimum instead of only fixing one missing import. Require osc-lib>=4.6.0 in build/test and runtime dependencies, matching pinned requirements.txt. ClientManager endpoint checks now pass region_name and interface positional arguments to is_service_available; archive osc-lib 4.4.0 only accepts service_type and raises TypeError. The expanded API is provided by upstream osc-lib commit 47dd091083b1c88e09dcb8c2952e8317773bab03 (first released in 4.6.0). Preserve all tests.
